<strong>Antes de demostrar, di qué métod: Before proving, say which method you are using. Direct, contrapositive, reduction to absurdity or induction. Writing it on the first line organises the rest and avoids the proof that goes round without arriving.
<strong>En una estimación, escribe los s: In an estimate, write down the assumptions. What is marked is not the final number but whether the chain of assumptions is reasonable and the units match. A good result with hidden assumptions is worth nothing.
<strong>Niega por partes, no de golpe.</: Negate piece by piece, not all at once. Swap each quantifier for the other one and negate only the end. The negation of “all swans are white” is not “none of them is”: it is “there is one that is not”, and that difference is worth a whole exercise.
<strong>Sigue el pseudocódigo con una ta: Follow the pseudocode with a table. One column per variable, one row per pass. It is the same table you will use in the machines block, and here it already prevents the mistake of miscounting the passes.
Cada tramo aporta un número fijo de preg: Each section contributes a fixed number of questions, drawn at random from its topics without repeating a topic while that is possible, and avoiding the most basic exercises. With 5 topics and 6 questions, one exam covers almost the whole block: that is why the link at the end reproduces the same exam, and “another exam” draws a different one.
Cinco temas que no enseñan a calcular na: Five topics that teach you to calculate nothing: they teach you to say things precisely and to check that what you said is true. This topic teaches nothing new: it asks. A procedural exam with exercises from the whole block, with a clock and no hints, to know whether the language the rest of the course is written in —[[lg-proposiciones|the proposition]], [[lg-conjuntos|the set]] and [[lg-demostracion|the proof]]— has stuck.
Cómo sacarle partido: How to get the most out of it
El caso base es la parte corta y la bara: The base case is the short, cheap part. If time has to be shared out, the inductive step is where nearly all the marks are.
El caso base sin paso inductivo es una c: The base case without the inductive step is a check, not a proof. One fallen domino does not knock the row down: you need to know that each one knocks over the next.
El enlace de un examen corregido reprodu: The link to a marked exam reproduces the same questions with the same numbers. A teacher can do one, copy the link and pass it to the class: everyone will sit the same exam and will be able to compare results and procedures.
Elegir el método de demostración que con: Choosing the right method of proof; completing the induction step; estimating an order of magnitude with invented but reasonable data; following an algorithm in pseudocode and saying what it returns and how many steps it takes.
Elige los tramos que entran. Las pregunt: Choose the sections to include. The questions are drawn at random from the exercises of each topic in the block, avoiding the most basic ones and without repeating a topic while possible. There are no hints: the marking and the step-by-step solution come on submitting.
En una pregunta de inducción compruebas: In an induction question you check that the formula holds for $n = 1$ and you run out of time. What have you proved?
Eso es justo lo que hay que demostrar, y: That is exactly what has to be proved, and it does not prove itself. There are formulas that fail from the fourth term on and are right for the first three.
Examen de lógica, demostración y problem: Exam on logic, proof and problem solving
La fórmula, porque si vale para el prime: The formula, because if it holds for the first one it holds for all
Los exámenes orales de las universidades: The oral examinations of the mediaeval universities were disputationes: one student defended a thesis and others attacked it with counterexamples, and whoever could not be caught in a contradiction won. What was asked for was not the result but the reasoning, exactly as in this block. The custom survives in the defence of a doctoral thesis, which is still called that.
Media demostración, que suele puntuar la: Half a proof, which usually scores half
Nada todavía: falta el paso que va de $n: Nothing yet: the step from $n$ to $n + 1$ is missing
Negar una proposición con cuantificadore: Negating a proposition with quantifiers; deciding whether an implication is true and telling it apart from its converse; working with unions, intersections and complements; knowing whether a map is injective, surjective or bijective.
Un examen de bloque es un simulacro hech: A block exam is a mock paper taken at home: with a clock, no notes and no hints. The questions come from the exercises of the 5 topics of the block, spread across sections, and every time you start one the numbers are different and so are the topics: doing it several times covers the whole block. On submission everything is marked, the step-by-step solution of each question opens, and the mark comes out section by section, with links to what is worth revising. The “tailored to what you have done” option puts first what you have not solved yet: it is the way to check that no topic is left untouched.
